name: validate-focused-full-layering
title: Add explicit focused/full validate layering and safer timeout defaults for workflow efficiency baseline item 1
description: B-4bd7 registered the workflow-efficiency baseline after B-e9cb showed that full validation was expensive and a too-tight timeout could create false failure pressure. This story fixes only the validate-cost dimension by making focused validation explicit for development/review while preserving the final full validation requirement.
